# em portageq get_repo_path

Print each repository's location

## Usage

```
em portageq get_repo_path [OPTIONS] <EROOT> [REPO]...
```

## Arguments

* `<EROOT>`
* `[REPO]...`

## Options

* `-h, --help` — Print help (see a summary with '-h')

## Global options

* `--color <WHEN>` — \[default: auto\]
  * `auto`: Colour when stdout is a terminal.
  * `always`: Always colour.
  * `never`: Never colour.
